items.source: If the class has a single parameterized constructor, one property is created per constructor parameter, unless the constructor is annotated with @Autowired. If the class has a constructor explicitly annotated with @ConstructorBinding, one property is created per constructor parameter for that constructor. Otherwise, properties are discovered through the presence of standard getters and setters with special handling for collection and map types (that is detected even if only a getter is present). The annotation processor also supports the use of the @Data, @Value, @Getter, and @Setter lombok annotations.
items.translation: 如果该类具有单个参数化构造函数，除非该构造函数被标注为 @Autowired，否则将为每个构造函数参数创建一个属性。 如果该类具有一个显式标注为 @ConstructorBinding 的构造函数，则为此构造函数的每个参数创建一个属性。 否则，将通过标准 getter 和 setter 的存在来发现属性，并对集合和 Map 类型进行特殊处理（即使仅存在 getter 也能检测到）。 注解处理器还支持使用 lombok 注解 @Data、@Value、@Getter 和 @Setter。

items.source: This exposes three properties where my.server.name has no default and my.server.ip and my.server.port defaults to "127.0.0.1" and 9797 respectively. The Javadoc on fields is used to populate the description attribute. For instance, the description of my.server.ip is "IP address to listen to.".
items.translation: 这暴露了三个属性，其中 my.server.name 没有默认值，而 my.server.ip 和 my.server.port 的默认值分别为 "127.0.0.1" 和 9797。 字段的 Javadoc 用于填充 description 属性。 例如，my.server.ip 的描述为 "IP address to listen to."。

items.source: The preceding example produces metadata information for my.server.name, my.server.host.ip, and my.server.host.port properties. You can use the @NestedConfigurationProperty annotation on a field or a getter method to indicate that a regular (non-inner) class should be treated as if it were nested.
items.translation: 前面的示例为 my.server.name、my.server.host.ip 和 my.server.host.port 属性生成元数据信息。您可以在字段或 getter 方法上使用 @NestedConfigurationProperty 注解，以指示应将普通（非内部）类视为嵌套类。

items.source: The processor picks up both classes and methods that are annotated with @ConfigurationProperties. It also picks classes that are annotated with @ConfigurationPropertiesSource
items.translation: 处理器会拾取所有带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的类和属性。它还会拾取带有 @ConfigurationPropertiesSource 注解的类。

items.source: If a type located in another module is used in a @ConfigurationProperties-annotated type, some metadata elements cannot be discovered automatically. Reusing the example above, if Host is located in another module, full metadata is not available as the annotation processor does not have access to the source of Host.
items.translation: 如果另一个模块中的类型被用于 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的类型中，则无法自动发现某些元数据元素。 重新使用上面的示例，如果 `Host` 位于另一个模块中，则无法获取完整的元数据，因为注解处理器无法访问 `Host` 的源代码。

items.source: You can easily generate your own configuration metadata file from items annotated with @ConfigurationProperties by using the spring-boot-configuration-processor jar. The jar includes a Java annotation processor which is invoked as your project is compiled.
items.translation: 您可以使用 `spring-boot-configuration-processor` jar 文件，轻松生成由带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的项目项生成的自定义配置元数据文件。 该 jar 文件包含一个 Java 注解处理器，在项目编译时会被调用。

items.source: If you are using an additional-spring-configuration-metadata.json file, the compileJava task should be configured to depend on the processResources task, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 如果您使用 additional-spring-configuration-metadata.json 文件，则应将 compileJava 任务配置为依赖于 processResources 任务，如下例所示：

items.source: If you are using Lombok in your project, you need to make sure that its annotation processor runs before spring-boot-configuration-processor. To do so with Maven, list the annotation processors in the required order using the annotationProcessors attribute of the Maven compiler plugin. With Gradle, declare the dependencies in the annotationProcessor configuration in the required order.
items.translation: 如果您在项目中使用了 Lombok，请确保其注解处理器在 spring-boot-configuration-processor 之前运行。 使用 Maven 时，请在 Maven 编译器插件的 `annotationProcessors` 属性中按所需顺序列出注解处理器。 使用 Gradle 时，请在 `annotationProcessor` 配置中按所需顺序声明依赖项。

items.source: The description attribute can only be populated when the type is available as source code that is being compiled. It will not be populated when the type is only available as a compiled class from a dependency. For such cases, you can source the metadata or provide manual entries.
items.translation: `description` 属性仅在类型作为正在编译的源代码可用时才能填充。当类型仅作为依赖项的编译类可用时，该属性不会被填充。对于此类情况，您可以获取元数据或提供手动条目。

items.source: If you use @ConfigurationProperties with record class then record components' descriptions should be provided via class-level Javadoc tag @param (there are no explicit instance fields in record classes to put regular field-level Javadocs on).
items.translation: 如果您使用@ConfigurationProperties配合记录类（record class），则必须通过类级别的 Javadoc 标签@param提供记录组件的描述（因为记录类中没有显式的实例字段来放置常规字段级别的 Javadoc）。

items.source: Spring Boot’s configuration file handling is quite flexible, and it is often the case that properties may exist that are not bound to a @ConfigurationProperties bean. You may also need to tune some attributes of an existing key or to ignore the key altogether. To support such cases and let you provide custom "hints", the annotation processor automatically merges items from META-INF/additional-spring-configuration-metadata.json into the main metadata file.
items.translation: Spring Boot 的配置文件处理非常灵活，通常情况下可能存在一些未绑定到 @ConfigurationProperties Bean 的属性。 您可能还需要调整现有键的一些属性，或者完全忽略该键。 为了支持此类情况并让您提供自定义“提示”，注解处理器会自动将 META-INF/additional-spring-configuration-metadata.json 中的项合并到主元数据文件中。

items.source: If you are using AspectJ in your project, you need to make sure that the annotation processor runs only once. There are several ways to do this. With Maven, you can configure the maven-apt-plugin explicitly and add the dependency to the annotation processor only there. You could also let the AspectJ plugin run all the processing and disable annotation processing in the maven-compiler-plugin configuration, as follows:
items.translation: 如果您在项目中使用了 AspectJ，请确保注解处理器仅运行一次。 有几种方法可以实现这一点。 使用 Maven 时，您可以显式配置 maven-apt-plugin，并仅在该项目中为注解处理器添加依赖项。 您也可以让 AspectJ 插件执行所有处理工作，并在 maven-compiler-plugin 配置中禁用注解处理，如下所示：

items.translation: 这为 Host 在 META-INF/spring/configuration-metadata/com.example.Host.json 中生成元数据，并且当注解处理器处理此类类型时会自动重用。

items.source: You can also annotate a parent class located in another module that a @ConfigurationProperties-annotated type extends from.
items.translation: 您还可以注解位于另一个模块中的父类，该父类被一个带有 @ConfigurationProperties 注解的类型继承。

items.source: When generating source metadata for a type, you can also craft custom metadata for that type, for example com.example.SomeType, in META-INF/spring/configuration/metadata/com.example.SomeType.json.
items.translation: 在为类型生成源元数据时，您还可以为该类型（例如 com.example.SomeType）在 META-INF/spring/configuration/metadata/com.example.SomeType.json 中创建自定义元数据。

items.source: The format of the additional metadata file is exactly the same as the regular spring-configuration-metadata.json. The items contained in the “ignored.properties” section are removed from the “properties” section of the generated spring-configuration-metadata.json file.
items.translation: 附加元数据文件的格式与常规的 spring-configuration-metadata.json 完全相同。 “ignored.properties”部分中包含的项目将从生成的 spring-configuration-metadata.json 文件的“properties”部分中移除。

items.source: The annotation processor applies a number of heuristics to extract the default value from the source model. Default values can only be extracted when the type is available as source code that is being compiled. They will not be extracted when the type is only available as a compiled class from a dependency. Furthermore, default values have to be provided statically. In particular, do not refer to a constant defined in another class. Also, the annotation processor cannot auto-detect default values for Collectionss.
items.translation: 注解处理器应用多种启发式规则从源模型中提取默认值。仅当类型作为正在编译的源代码可用时，才能提取默认值；如果类型仅作为依赖项的已编译类可用，则不会提取默认值。此外，默认值必须静态提供。特别是，不要引用定义在其他类中的常量。另外，注解处理器无法自动检测 Collections 的默认值。
